What has actually been verified?

The supplied six-class MobileNetV2 checkpoint loads correctly, predicts a valid label, works with the existing API, and correctly handles multiple valid and invalid upload types. Six-class preprocessing is consistent with the application. Synthetic patterns were used only to test endpoint behavior, not recognition accuracy.

30 automated checks12 ASGI synthetic diagnostics35 real HTTP synthetic requestsNo original Python files edited
Accuracy has not been measured on waste photographs. The external evaluator is implemented and ready for RealWaste. Real labeled images were not available for this run, so any six-class accuracy, F1 or disposal-accuracy figure would be unsupported.

Observed performance: real localhost HTTP

The test launched the original FastAPI app with Uvicorn, posted 35 JPEG diagnostic samples over HTTP and checked the response schema and failure status for bad uploads. These times include HTTP over the local loopback interface, but not real camera, Wi-Fi, sensor, or LCD operations.

HTTP p50: 22.21 ms · p95: 25.18 ms · p99: 43.44 ms. These are environment-specific measurements; they do not certify the system-wide five-second requirement.

Out-of-distribution model diagnostics

The trained model was asked to classify 12 artificial color and shape patterns. The purpose is to expose API behavior on unfamiliar inputs and show confidence levels, not to assign correct trash/recycling labels.

Some synthetic patterns returned high model confidence. Confidence is not correctness, and the API currently has no low-confidence retry/abstain threshold.

Ready for the next stage: external accuracy evaluation

The external evaluation script accepts UCI RealWaste with six exact material mappings. It produces counts and normalized confusion matrices, per-class precision/recall/F1, calibration, latency, correct/error image galleries, and optional lighting/blur/compression/occlusion comparisons based on actual model predictions.

cd SmartSort_Test_Suite
python evaluate_external.py --dataset "/path/to/realwaste-main" \
  --source realwaste --out results/realwaste --robustness

Exact duplicates may be screened against original training files using --train-dir. Item-level Iowa City acceptance requires separately verified per-image labels; generic material categories cannot establish it.

Smart Sort • Results are specific to the uploaded checkpoint and this CPU testing environment. Original project files and checkpoint remain unchanged.
